errors.busy: Search is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.server: Search failed on the server. Try again.
errors.timeout: Search timed out. Try a more specific query.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the Fyr server.

search.placeholder: Search books, articles, maps and places…

idle.title: Find anything in your offline library
idle.body: One search covers book titles, article titles in every ZIM archive (and article text once an archive has a full-text index), the text of Markdown and EPUB books, map files and named places in your POI files.
idle.tip: Tip: press {slash} anywhere to jump to search, {arrows} to pick a result and {enter} to open it.

empty.title: No matches for “{query}”
empty.body: Try fewer or different words, check the spelling, or switch the filter back to {all}.
empty.partial: The search time limit was reached before every archive was checked.

search.partial: The search time limit was reached; some archives may not have been fully searched. A more specific query is faster.
